claude-haiku-5-5.note: Prices for prompts up to 100,000 tokens. A prompt over 100,000 tokens (cache reads and writes included) pays 5x: $0.50 / $2.50 / $0.625 / $1 / $0.05. Not modelled: every StoryTime helper prompt is under 15,000 tokens.

glm-5.3-flash.note: NOT A PUBLISHED PRICE (issue #132). The Understudy catalog publishes none, so this is one effective rate for input and output alike, from the gateway's own bill for 2026-11-06..11: $6.0013 for 18.15M input+output tokens = $0.331 per million, rounded up to $0.35 so the budget cap and the cost page over-count by about 6% on that mix. A story's real cost is what `understudy billing usage-by-model` says for its window.
